messages:
Ben (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need to finalize the deprecation cadence for the old /v1/response-envelope and the legacy signer header across marketplace images, on-prem bundles, and SI installs. Can partners expect a single rollout or staggered windows?
Anna (DevEx): Staggered is safer. Marketplace images often get delayed cert/key rotations because of the deploy review process. :warning:
Suresh (HW Partner): Agreed. Our on-prem customers run with restricted maintenance windows. If you flip the signer header too quickly, our installers will fail. We need at least a 6-week grace period and a fallback shim in SDKs.
Maria (PM): Proposal: 3-phase plan — 1) announcement + migration docs (2 weeks), 2) soft-deprecation (accept both headers for 6 weeks, telemetry only), 3) enforcement (remove legacy header). Total ~8–10 weeks. Thoughts?
Anna (DevEx): That's reasonable. We'll ship SDK shims that accept both headers and emit a warning log. Also add a feature-flag so partners can opt into new header early. Example shim:
```js
// in http client
const signature = req.headers['x-rdwd-signature-v2'] || req.headers['x-rdwd-sign'];
if (!req.headers['x-rdwd-signature-v2']) console.warn('legacy signature used — rotate keys');
```
Suresh (HW Partner): Can you make the shim tiny (single-file)? Our SI integrators prefer patching an agent binary rather than changing multiple services.
Anna (DevEx): Yep — single helper lib and a CLI patch script for on-prem installers. We'll publish both to the marketplace and the partner portal.
Ben (Partnerships): Marketplace note — we must coordinate with Marketplace Ops. They need 7 biz days to vet new images and a different approval path for signed-on‑prem bundles.
DeployBot: marketplace/publish: image-v2-signing queued — ETA 9 days (workflow id: wf_8a3f).
Maria (PM): Action items: @Anna build shim + CLI patch (due EOD next Tue), @Suresh confirm maintenance windows and send list of high-risk customers, @Ben engage Marketplace Ops and legal for announcement wording. I'll draft the partner-facing timeline.
Suresh (HW Partner): List coming today. Also: note about key rotation — some customers use HSM with manual ops. We should offer a temporary manual verification flow rather than forcing fully automated rotation.
Anna (DevEx): Good call. We'll add a manual verification flag to the CLI and document the step-by-step.
Ben (Partnerships): One more: public announcement cadence. We should avoid a hard cut before SI-run upgrades are scheduled. Maria, please include an opt-out window for SIs to postpone by up to 2 weeks with a signed runbook.
Maria (PM): Will do. I'll also create a short migration checklist for SIs: (1) update SDK to shim, (2) run CLI patch, (3) run canary test, (4) certify with partner sign-off.
Anna (DevEx): We can also add telemetry tag 'legacy_signer_used' to track adoption. If adoption < 90% at week 5, we'll extend grace period.
Ben (Partnerships): Perfect. Final ask: can Marketplace Ops add a compatibility badge for images that include the shim? Helps partners surface compliant bundles.
DeployBot: ticket #MP-721 created for compatibility badge flow.
Suresh (HW Partner): Thanks — keeping this gradual will save SIs from emergency rollbacks. I'll circulate the customer impact matrix after lunch.
Ben (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. Next checkpoint: Tue EOD sync in #partnerships — 10 min. If anything blocks earlier, ping me or drop notes in this thread. :thumbsup:
